## Interview (one prompt at run start)
Destructive writes: never (destructive capability denied for this run)

Walkthrough: numbered drafts overnight, final in the morning | none

## Units
p1 Add the export endpoint (new) depends on: none
p2 Show exports in the dashboard (new) depends on: p1
p3 Document exports (new) depends on: p1

## Schedule p1
1. build: git worktree add -b overnight/p1 <worktree> origin/main
   gate: ON-1 one unit under the fenced lease; expect: worktree on the unit branch
2. local-ci: /cf:drive quick --local-only
   gate: tests and lint green; expect: green locally
3. review-gate: ruby ~/.claude/cf/bin/review_ack.rb <session_id>
   gate: review gate released; expect: review recorded
4. change-gate: ruby ~/.claude/cf/bin/change_run.rb all
   gate: cf:change pass for the head sha; expect: gate recorded
5. merge: gh pr merge <pr> --squash --admin --match-head-commit <sha>
   gate: ON-3 merge mode and SW-2; expect: merged at <sha>
6. staging-deploy: gh run list --workflow deploy-staging.yml --commit <sha> --json databaseId,headSha,status; Monitor gh run watch <id> --exit-status
   gate: deploy identity matches <sha>; expect: run succeeded; deadline: discovery 10m, deploy 45m
7. staging-version: curl -fsS https://app.example.test/version
   gate: ON-10 before any smoke; expect: deployed version equals <sha>
8. staging-smoke: /cf:qa --suite overnight-smoke (flag on, temporary)
   gate: flags adapter tested at intake (planned: set then read back in staging); expect: pass; deadline: smoke 15m
9. production-tag: ruby ~/.claude/cf/bin/change_run.rb all --for-tag <tag> && git push origin <tag>
   gate: ON-4 change_tag_guard.rb; expect: tag v* at <sha>
10. production-deploy: gh run list --workflow deploy-production.yml --commit <sha> --json databaseId,headSha,status; Monitor gh run watch <id> --exit-status
   gate: deploy identity matches <sha>; expect: run succeeded; deadline: discovery 10m, deploy 45m
11. production-version: curl -fsS https://app.example.test/version
   gate: ON-10 before any smoke; expect: deployed version equals <sha>
12. smoke-flag-off: /cf:qa --suite overnight-smoke (flag off)
   gate: flags adapter tested at intake (planned: set then read back in staging); expect: pass; deadline: smoke 15m
13. smoke-flag-on: /cf:qa --suite overnight-smoke (flag on)
   gate: flags adapter tested at intake (planned: set then read back in staging); expect: pass; deadline: smoke 15m
14. smoke-flag-off-again: /cf:qa --suite overnight-smoke (flag off)
   gate: flags adapter tested at intake (planned: set then read back in staging); expect: pass; deadline: smoke 15m
15. flag-final: set the agreed-final flag state, then read it back
   gate: flags adapter tested at intake (planned: set then read back in staging); expect: read-back equals the agreed-final state
16. healthy: curl -fsS https://app.example.test/version
   gate: next-unit rule; expect: healthy at <sha>

## Reservations
budget: 5.00 USD
cf:walkthrough --estimate-only (free)
cf:walkthrough --draft --none --roast-max-usd 2.00 --max-usd 1.00: reserve 3.00 USD (fits)
keys: cf_keys.rb status checked at intake, never enrolled in a dry-run

## Pacing
Monitor: gh run watch <id> --exit-status per deploy; a Monitor failure falls back to one gh run view <id>
ScheduleWakeup: fallback every 25 minutes (20 to 30), deduped by a stored next-wake id
in-session only: a closed session is resumed by a human with /cf:overnight resume <run-id>
